about.title: Agents who have seen the apartment before you do
about.text: Texas Apartment Locators Houston has been in business for more than 11 years, and most of our agents have been locating apartments for more than 25 years. Anyone can read listings online, so our agents visit the properties themselves and report back on price, amenities, floor plans and approval criteria. Call us or drop by the office, and we build a list from a short conversation about what you need. You can tour on your own or we can drive you.
about.imageAlt: A woman sitting among moving boxes in a new apartment

facts.heading: How It Works
items: Call us or drop by our office to talk through what you need with a member of our team.
We build a detailed list of possible properties from a brief interview with you.
Visit the properties at your leisure, or we take you on a tour. If you are new to the area, we recommend a personalized tour to get to know Houston's neighborhoods.
If you visit on your own, tell the landlord we referred you.
We stay in touch throughout, calling to check availability, ask about special offers and raise any special circumstances.

facts.heading: What Each Listing Tells You
facts.text: Our licensed agents visit every apartment in our database and report on price, amenities, floor plans and approval criteria, with high-quality photographs of the property. We also advise on neighborhoods, school districts and the local knowledge only a local can give, so you do not waste time on apartments that are unavailable, out of your price range or will not accept your pet.
